info.name: CrowdStock Backend Endpoints
info.description: Every backend endpoint the CrowdStock app calls, against the live StockLab gateway (theKey/myhandler pattern). Run "1. Get Bearer Token" and "2. Login" once at the start of a session — every other request auto-mints its own single-use session token via the collection Pre-request Script, so you can just hit Send on any of them after that. Environment: CrowdStock-Backend.postman_environment.json (import alongside this collection and select it).

exec: // Auto-mints session credentials so every request below "just works" on Send.
// Bearer tokens last ~1000h (cached); trans_token (refID) is SINGLE-USE per
// the app's own backendClient.ts, so it is re-minted before every call that
console.warn("No session_id yet — run 'Login (G22)' in the Auth folder first.");

request.description: Bootstrap credential for the app itself (not per-user). Response: {status, message, token}.
Real password, not a numeric PIN, despite the PinCode field name. Response: {IsValid, SessionID, SlotAmount, WBalance, Profile:{...}}.
Mints a fresh, single-use trans_token from the SessionID. Response: {success, trans_token}.
Canonical profile refresh. WBalance here is stale — use G25 for real-time balance.
Session-exempt. Sends a reset OTP to the phone.
CONFIRMED to currently return {success:false} regardless of input — not configured server-side yet.

item.name: Get Round Results by Date (G13, explicit date)

request.description: Swap the date field to any YYYY-MM-DD to inspect a specific day's settlement — this is the endpoint behind the "gain not showing" bug: check every record's GLN vs Gain vs Loss fields.
CAUTION: this is a REAL play — it stakes test_amount from the live balance on test_round. Only run against a round that is actually open.
CONFIRMED live backend bug as of last check: fails with "Unable to convert MySQL date/time value to System.DateTime" even with the correct request shape.

item.name: Get Played Round Indices Today (G15, Code P)
Get Auto Play Config, All 24 Rounds (A2)

request.description: Status 0 = OFF (omit Figure entirely when turning off — the backend keeps the existing Figure). Status 1 = ON (Figure required).

item.name: Turn OFF One Round's Auto Play (A1)

request.description: Status 1 = all on, 0 = all off. Does not change each round's stored Figure.
Canonical real-time balance — used everywhere in the app instead of G22/G24's WBalance.

item.name: Get Game Outcomes — Gain/Loss/Neutral (G15, Code G)

request.description: CONFIRMED live 2026-09-20: Code "G" returns LabelID IN (G,L,N), not gains only. THE BUG: every record with GLN="G" seen so far still has Gain=0.000000 with the real magnitude sitting in Loss instead, even when GLN claims a gain — check the settlement job that populates the Gain field specifically.
Pre-summed {D,W,G,P} for the month. Cross-check this "G" total against summing Code=G records above by hand.
Same as G15B but scoped to today.

item.name: Get Bank Profile — Deposit + Payout Accounts (BB)

request.description: Idempotent — returns the existing virtual account if one exists, otherwise creates one.
Third-party (VigiPay-style) name enquiry. Response nests under responseData.accountName.

item.name: Set Payout Bank Details, First Time (PP)

request.description: Can only be set once per account per Mr Yemi's doc. Sends BankCode under two field names (BankCode + outbankcode) — CONFIRMED live that PP only persists outbankcode; BankCode alone is silently dropped.
Same G20 as password reset — reused purely as an OTP-delivery mechanism, no password is actually changed by this flow.
Requires the OTP from G20 above plus the account's real login password as PinCode.

CAUTION: real money movement. CONFIRMED live as of the last UAT round: consistently fails with PAYOUT_FAILED regardless of input — likely a Sling-sandbox issue on the backend, not a request-format problem. Re-test this one specifically.

item.name: Check If a Phone Is Registered (B2)

request.description: Swap the phone number in the body to check any contact. A false/not-registered result also comes back as IsValid:false — that's expected here, not a session error.
